newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia CPI rose 0.2 percent in November.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia CPI rose 0.2 percent in November.

text.p: Tunisia's consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.2 percent in November compared with October, official figures showed on Thursday.
The average level of consumer prices in the first 11 months of the year was 3.8 percent higher than in the corresponding period of 1995.
Between January and end-November this year, the CPI rose by 2.9 percent compared with a 5.3 percent increase over the same period of 1995.
Details for the month-on-month percentage change-- Food +0.1, leisure +0.1, clothing +0.7, health +0.3, transportation 0.0, and housing +0.2
